title: Anamorphosis

inlines.v: ANAMORPHOSIS, noun [Gr. formation.] In perspective drawings, a deformed or distorted portrait or figure, which, in one point of view, is confused or unintelligible, and in another, is an exact and regular representation; or confused to the naked eye, but reflected from a plain or curved mirror, appearing regular, and in right proportion.
